headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger's test indicates no significant funnel plot asymmetry (p=0.2568). The distribution of studies appears symmetric, suggesting a lower risk of publication bias.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 50 studies yielded an effect size of 0.99 (95% CI: 0.96–1.01), indicating no statistically significant association between dairy and breast cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 84.09%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
